• SEO and website improvements – from technical audits and on-page fixes to authority-building outreach 
• Social media management and content – planning the calendar, writing posts, designing creatives and keeping engagement lively on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and similar platforms

Most of the sites you will touch are WordPress brochure sites, Shopify or other online stores, plus a few custom-built business portals. A working knowledge of HTML, CSS, basic PHP or JavaScript is therefore important so you can install pixels, fix speed issues, tweak layouts and keep everything tracking correctly.

Your responsibility runs from strategy to reporting:

1. Prepare the plan, KPIs and timelines. 
2. Build or improve the assets (content, ads, landing pages). 
3. Launch, monitor and optimise campaigns daily. 
4. Deliver clear fortnightly reports with data-driven next steps.

All collaboration happens in English over Slack and Google Workspace during core IST hours. Because quick coordination with my in-house dev team is vital, I prefer marketers based in India who can jump on a call when needed.

If you have managed full-funnel campaigns before, understand GA4, GTM and Data Studio, and can back your ideas with results, let’s talk. Please share two recent projects that match the scope above, noting the growth achieved and the exact role you played.

projects.title: Tally-Based GST & Accounting Support
projects.full_description:
I manage a growing portfolio of service-oriented businesses and freelancers who rely on me for end-to-end finance oversight. I’m looking for an accountant deeply familiar with Tally to step in and keep their books clean, compliant, and up-to-date.

You’ll also generate and track invoices, match incoming payments, and flag discrepancies long before they become problems.

Deliverables I expect from you 
• Accurate, fully reconciled Tally data for every client at month-end 
• GST returns submitted within statutory deadlines, with working papers archived for reference 
• A concise balance sheet & P&L package each month, ready for client hand-off 
• Ongoing bank, payment-gateway, and expense matching so nothing slips through the cracks

I’ll provide secure Tally access, previous period data, and a clear schedule of filing dates. If you’re confident handling multiple service-sector books simultaneously and can communicate issues proactively, let’s talk—my goal is to build a long-term, reliability-focused relationship.

projects.title: Long-Term Clinic & Real Estate Web Builder
projects.full_description:
# Hiring: Long-Term Website Developer / Website Builder for Clinics & Real Estate Businesses

## About the Opportunity

I am building a service business that provides premium, modern websites to businesses, initially focusing on **clinics, doctors, healthcare practices, real estate agents, and property businesses**.

I am looking for a reliable, skilled website developer or website-building specialist who can work with me on a long-term basis.

This is not a one-time project. I plan to generate leads through my sales team and provide you with the client requirements, business details, content, images, and other necessary information. Your responsibility will be to turn these leads into professionally designed, fully functional, live websites.

The ideal person should be comfortable handling recurring projects, delivering quickly without compromising quality, and providing ongoing technical support.

## 1. Scope of Work

For every client, I will provide the available business information, requirements, branding assets, images, contact details, and other relevant inputs.

You will be responsible for:

* Designing and building a premium, professional website suited to the client's business.
* Creating mobile-responsive websites that work smoothly across smartphones, tablets, and desktops.
* Ensuring the design looks modern, polished, trustworthy, and conversion-focused.
* Adding contact forms, WhatsApp integration, click-to-call buttons, Google Maps, appointment enquiry forms, property enquiry forms, and other relevant features as required.
* Implementing basic on-page SEO, appropriate page titles, meta descriptions, image optimization, and sitemap configuration.
* Setting up the domain, hosting, SSL certificate, and deployment, with the client's or my approval and access.
* Testing all pages, forms, buttons, links, mobile layouts, and essential functionality before launch.
* Making the website live and handing over the required access and documentation.
* Providing post-launch maintenance, bug fixes, and technical support.

## 2. Types of Websites

Initially, the focus will be on the following categories.

**A. Clinics and healthcare businesses**

* Clinic and doctor profile websites.
* Specialties, treatments, services, and facilities pages.
* Doctor profiles and consultation enquiry forms.
* Appointment requests and WhatsApp contact integration.
* Clinic location, timings, and contact information.

**B. Real estate and property businesses**

* Real estate agent and property consultant websites.
* Property listing and property detail pages.
* Property enquiry forms and WhatsApp integration.
* Image galleries, location information, and lead capture.
* Project showcase pages for builders and property developers.

The ability to work across other local business categories in the future will be an advantage.

## 3. Delivery Timeline

Speed is an important part of this business model.

* A standard website should ideally be delivered within **24–36 hours** after receiving complete requirements and assets.
* More complex websites with multiple pages, property catalogues, custom functionality, or integrations may require additional time, agreed upon before work begins.
* You must communicate realistic timelines and flag missing information immediately.
* Every website must go through quality checks before being launched.

I am not looking for rushed, generic websites that look unfinished. I need a repeatable process that combines speed with premium quality.

## 4. Design and Quality Expectations

The websites must look like professionally designed business websites, not basic templates with a logo and a few paragraphs added.

I expect:

* Premium UI/UX and clean visual hierarchy.
* Consistent typography, spacing, colours, and branding.
* Strong mobile-first design.
* Fast loading and optimized images.
* Clear calls to action that encourage enquiries and conversions.
* Relevant layouts for each business instead of using the exact same design for every client.
* No broken links, non-functional forms, placeholder content, or unfinished sections at launch.

You may use modern website builders, reusable components, AI-assisted tools, or custom development, provided the final quality is high and the websites remain maintainable.

## 5. Preferred Tools and Technology

You can recommend the best technology stack for this business model.

Possible options include:

* WordPress with a suitable page builder.
* Framer or Webflow.
* Modern AI-assisted website development tools.
* Custom development when genuinely required.

Please explain which tools you recommend for rapid delivery, good design quality, affordable hosting, easy maintenance, and scalability.

I prefer a standardized workflow with reusable components and templates wherever appropriate, while still ensuring that each client's website feels unique.

## 6. Hosting, Domain and Deployment

You will be expected to help take websites from development to production.

This includes:

* Connecting the client's domain.
* Configuring hosting and SSL.
* Deploying the final website.
* Testing the live website.
* Explaining recurring hosting, domain, plugin, or subscription costs before they are incurred.

Domains, hosting, premium plugins, and third-party subscriptions should be discussed and approved separately. Please clarify which accounts should be owned by me or the client and which access you require.

All client websites, domains, accounts, source files, and business data must remain under the appropriate client's or my control, with access handed over as agreed.

## 7. Long-Term Maintenance and Support

This is a continuing engagement, not a one-off development job.

After launch, I need support for:

* Fixing bugs and broken functionality.
* Resolving deployment and hosting issues.
* Minor content, image, contact detail, and layout updates.
* Troubleshooting forms, WhatsApp links, and integrations.
* Website backups and basic security updates where applicable.
* Communicating any issues that could affect a client's live website.

Please specify what maintenance is included, your response times, and what would be charged separately. Major redesigns, new features, and significant additional pages can be quoted separately.

## 8. Expected Monthly Workload

I expect to generate approximately **20–30 qualified business leads per month**, with the potential for recurring website projects as the sales operation grows.

Not every lead will necessarily convert, and actual project volume will depend on client requirements and sales conversions.

I am looking for someone who can begin with a few projects, establish a reliable workflow, and scale capacity as the business grows. Please share how many standard websites you can realistically deliver per week and per month while maintaining quality.

Reliability, communication, and long-term commitment are important.

## 9. Commercial Proposal

Please provide your pricing for:

1. A standard 4–5-page clinic website.
2. A standard 4–5-page real estate business website.
3. A more advanced property website with multiple listings and detail pages.
4. Additional pages and custom functionality.
5. Domain and hosting setup.
6. Monthly maintenance and support.
7. Urgent delivery within 24–36 hours.
8. A monthly package for recurring website projects.

I am interested in a competitive per-website rate or a mutually beneficial monthly arrangement as volume increases.

Please separate your development fees from hosting, domains, paid tools, and other third-party costs. I would like to start with a paid trial project before committing to a larger volume.

## 10. How to Apply

Please include the following in your proposal:

1. Your portfolio with at least three live websites you have personally built.
2. Examples of clinic, doctor, healthcare, real estate, or other local business websites.
3. The tools and technology you use.
4. Your typical turnaround time for a 4–5-page website.
5. Your price per website and monthly maintenance fee.
6. Your realistic weekly and monthly delivery capacity.
7. How you handle hosting, deployment, backups, an

projects.title: Build FitBug AI Wellness App Prototype
projects.full_description:
We’re looking for an experienced mobile app designer and React Native developer to design and build a working, interactive **iOS and Android mobile app prototype** for FitBug, a wellness platform centred on a personalized AI companion and professional coaching.

This project is for a mobile app—not a website or static screen presentation. We need a realistic app experience that can later connect to our existing backend services.

**Who the app serves**

FitBug supports several perspectives:

- **Individuals and families:** Personal wellbeing, coach discovery and subscriptions, messaging, diet and exercise plans, guided workouts, food logging, progress tracking, preventive wellness, family meals and grocery budgeting.
- **Coaches and professionals:** Client conversations, assessments, assigned routines, sessions, progress reviews and recommendations for further professional care.
- **Businesses:** Employee/member wellness programmes, participation management and appropriate reporting.
- **Communities:** Group activities, wellness initiatives, challenges and engagement.
- **Government/public programmes:** Programme administration, outreach, participation and aggregate reporting, with appropriate privacy and access controls.

**We will provide user journeys for each perspective.** You will help refine them, identify gaps, and translate them into simple navigation and complete mobile app workflows.

**The FitBug companion**

The companion is central to the app. It should provide brief, contextual greetings based on available logs, goals, routines, time of day and reported energy or stress.

Conversations should retain context, understand where the user entered chat, and avoid asking repeatedly for known information. Diet and exercise routines should be assigned only after discussion with the companion or a professional.

The companion should understand assigned coach routines, while private messages and other sensitive information remain subject to explicit sharing permissions.

For this prototype, realistic scripted responses and dummy data are acceptable. Actual AI model training is outside the initial scope.

**Deliverables**

- Mobile app user journeys, navigation and role-based flows
- Editable Figma designs and clickable prototype
- A consistent design system and reusable components
- A working Expo/React Native/TypeScript app prototype for iOS and Android
- Functional interactions, realistic sample data and saved progress
- Loading, empty, error, confirmation and permission states
- Source code, setup instructions and developer handover

**Ready for backend integration**

Our stack includes Expo, React Native, TypeScript, Expo Router, React Query and Supabase.

The mobile frontend must separate UI components, business rules and data access. Simulated services should use clearly defined interfaces so they can later be replaced with our actual backend services. Please document integration points and clearly identify simulated functionality.

**Delivery approach**

We prefer milestone-based delivery: agree the journeys and design system, complete one end-to-end individual member experience, then expand to the other perspectives.

Please share relevant mobile app examples, your approach, timeline and pricing. Quote UI/UX design and React Native frontend implementation separately, and explain what is included, excluded and required from us.

projects.title: Amharic & English Gameplay Script
projects.full_description:
I’m preparing a YouTube video where I play an action-packed, battle-style game and narrate the entire experience in a lively mix of Amharic and English. I need a complete script that lets me move through the match, react in real time, and weave a short story around the gameplay moments so viewers feel they’re right beside me.

Here’s what I’m looking for: 
• A cold-open hook (≈15 sec) that instantly pulls viewers in, switching naturally between the two languages. 
• Smooth scene-by-scene narration of one full match—include timestamps, key in-game events, and my in-character reactions (surprise, frustration, victory hype, etc.). 
• Short storytelling beats that tie those events together so it feels like a mini-plot rather than a simple play-through. 
• Light call-outs for sound effects or quick on-screen text I can add later. 
• A wrap-up that recaps the most exciting moment, thanks viewers, and invites likes/subs—all still in that Amharic-English blend.

Tone: energetic, conversational, and visibly reactive rather than instructional. Gameplay jargon is welcome as long as it’s clear in context. Keep transitions between languages smooth and purposeful—no random switching.

Deliverable: a ready-to-read script in Google Docs or Word, roughly 6–8 minutes of spoken content (about 900–1 100 words). If you game yourself and can suggest extra hype lines or clutch moments to highlight, even better.

I’ll provide the exact game title and any must-mention phrases once we start.

projects.title: Google Meet Live Note-Taking
projects.full_description:
I want a small, reliable tool that listens to spoken conversation in an active Google Meet and turns it into clear, well-formatted written notes while the meeting is still in progress. English is the only language I need to support, so you can focus all speech-to-text tuning, punctuation handling, and speaker-label logic on that single locale.

A concise overlay or side-panel inside the Meet window (or a separate browser tab if that’s simpler) is fine, as long as participants can scan the evolving notes without leaving the call. When the meeting ends, the full transcript should already be cleaned up and ready to copy or download—no post-processing delays.

Please include:

• Real-time transcription pipeline (Web Speech API, Google Cloud Speech-to-Text, or any comparable engine). 
• Automatic paragraphing and time stamps every few minutes so the text is readable. 
• Quick export to Google Docs and plain-text. 
• Simple start/stop controls the host can trigger.

You’re free to build a lightweight Chrome extension, a small web app that sits alongside Meet, or another approach that respects Google’s embedding policies; just outline your plan up front so I know how you’ll hook into the call’s audio.

Acceptance criteria 
– Live English transcription appears with <2 s latency during a Google Meet. 
– Accuracy stays above 90 % in a quiet office scenario. 
– Final document downloads automatically when the host clicks “End notes”.

Let me know which API or library you prefer and any permissions I’ll need to grant for testing.

projects.title: Boost Amazon Listing Visibility
projects.full_description:

First, I do not yet have a keyword bank or competitor benchmark, so the project begins with research. Please dig into Amazon itself, plus tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or Cerebro—whatever you trust—to uncover high-volume, highly relevant terms and the tactics my direct competitors are using. 

Once the research set is locked, turn the findings into action: 
• Craft a search-optimised product title and complete backend search-term string that maximises character limits without keyword stuffing. 
• Rewrite the five bullet points and full product description so they flow naturally for shoppers while weaving in priority keywords. The voice must remain consistent with my brand and comply with Amazon style guidelines. 

Acceptance criteria 
• A spreadsheet of at least 200 vetted keywords, tagged by relevance, volume, and competitiveness, plus a short competitor summary. 
• One SEO-optimised title (≤ 200 characters) and backend term set (≤ 249 bytes). 
• Five conversion-focused bullet points and a refreshed description delivered in both styled HTML and plain text, ready for upload. 

After delivery, I’ll upload the content and monitor the ranking shifts; timely tweaks based on early data may lead to follow-on work.

• Trainers 
• Pricing 
• Contact 

Key features

• Photo gallery and rotating customer testimonials for social proof. 
• Contact page with embedded Google Map and a separate inquiry form. 

Self-management
I want a custom React admin dashboard where I can update class schedules, pricing tables, and gallery images with no code. Clean, intuitive UI/UX is essential so day-to-day edits take minutes, not hours.

Tech stack
HTML / CSS, modern JavaScript, React for both the public site and the admin panel (open to a headless CMS or lightweight Node back end if that speeds development). Performance tuning, image optimisation, and basic on-page SEO need to be baked in from the start.

Deliverables
